title: Freeze
paragraphs: “W-What the heck!? Motoyasu’s head is smoking!”
“This is the first time I’ve actually seen someone start emitting smoke…”
“Motoyasu-sama!? For Motoyasu-sama to end up like this… What’s going to happen next?”
Yuki-chan ran over to me, then looked at Father and Kou. At this rate, things will get really bad for Kou.
“Kou, apologize right now! If even Motoyasu-sama, who knows the future, is reacting like this, something terrible is bound to happen!”
“Ehh? It’s fine! I’m not scared of Iwatani at all!”
“Hey, Naofumi… he’s completely looking down on you.”
“Since he knows you won’t attack, he’s treating you lightly.”

Oh? Ren just said the same thing Keel did last time. As Itsuki pointed out, Kou might be foolishly underestimating Father. …But now’s not the time to dwell on that! Move, my nearly frozen brain cells!
“…Kou, let me ask you one more time. What do you think Imiya-chan is?”
“Um, well, she’s being raised so that when she gets big enough, we can all cook and eat her, right?”
“…Listen, Kou. You seriously need to stop looking at Imiya-chan like that.”
“Ehh… But if it’s just a mole, I could eat it all by myself.”
“I will never let that happen. Promise me right here and now that you won’t, or else I’ll be angry too.”
“Ehh, no way. Besides, Iwatani couldn’t stop me even if he wanted to—no way, no how!”
GUHAA!! Kou’s unbelievably reckless words completely froze my brain.

After that, I lost consciousness. By the time I came to, Kou was tied up, bawling his eyes out, with different body part names scrawled all over him in charcoal. Looking around, Ren and Itsuki were trembling behind Éclair, using her as a shield. Even Yuki-chan and Sakura-chan were huddled together, shivering.

“Kou, do you know? We avoid it, but there actually is a culture of Filolial cuisine in this world. You said, ‘when they get big, everyone eats them together,’ right? Were you talking about yourself, by any chance?”
“Uuuh… Nooo! Kou is, Kou is—!”
“Well then… Looks like today’s a feast…”
Father’s voice took on that old, terrifying edge. He’s even scarier than he was in his original world.
“Imiya-chan, Kou’s weak point is right here.”
“A-Ahhh…”
“Don’t hold back, Imiya-chan. If you don’t do something, Kou might eat you instead.”
Mole was holding a knife… This is exactly like what happened with Keel! As the trembling mole locked eyes with Kou, Kou started shaking uncontrollably.
“HIIIII! Iwatani, stop it!”
“If Imiya-chan begged you to stop, would you? Even though Itsuki has asked you over and over to stop messing with his hair?”
“UWAAAAHHH!”
His scream was so piercing that even passersby near the inn were staring. Mole clung to Father, shaking its head desperately.
“It’s… It’s okay now. I’m happy you were worried about me, but… it’s enough…”
“Imiya-chan, you’re too kind.”
Father gave her a gentle smile. A sigh of relief… Or so I thought—because the next moment, his gaze shifted toward Ren and Itsuki.
“Well, it can’t be helped. In that case, let’s leave it to Ren or Itsuki. I mean, we’ll be arriving in Faubrey tomorrow anyway. Kou has no more use, right?”
“GYAAAAH!”
“D-Don’t drag us into this!”
“Exactly!”
“Itsuki… You were the one who asked me to do something, weren’t you? Come on, I’ll leave the task of finishing Kou off to you.”
“I-I never meant for it to go this far!”

Father smiled, and Itsuki trembled violently, shaking his head. This was the first time I had ever seen him with that kind of expression—even across all the loops. Even when we captured him during the last wave, he never looked like this.
“Sigh… Oh well. Be grateful for Imiya-chan and Itsuki’s kindness, okay? But if you ever target Imiya-chan again… I’ll be the one coming after you next.”
“Ugh… Okay… I’m sorry, I’m sorry! Mo—”
The moment Kou tried to say “Mole,” Father shot him a sharp glare.
“I-I’m sorry, Imiya-chan!”

As soon as Father untied him, Kou frantically bowed his head over and over, tears in his eyes, apologizing repeatedly. Ah… Is history doomed to repeat itself like this? Kou, I’m sorry I couldn’t protect you.
“So this is what Motoyasu was warning us about.”
“Th-That was some bone-chilling acting. Was it really just an act?”
“Well… it’s not like I was planning to take it that far, but if he hadn’t shown any remorse, I would have separated him from Imiya-chan.”
Father picked up Mole and gently patted its head. Mole, on the other hand, looked up at him with a complicated expression.
“Were you serious…?”
“Of course, it was just acting.”
Then, he turned to look at Kou. He bowed his head several more times before quietly settling down next to Yuki-chan. With this, Kou should calm down for a while.
“That wasn’t just casual banter earlier. You really shouldn’t make Naofumi mad.”
“He rarely gets angry, though… Maybe it’s because he’s always smiling, but that’s what makes it scarier when he does.”
“Now that you mention it, when we first met him, he seemed more easygoing. Almost a little frivolous.”
“He does like joking around. He just wants everyone to have fun together.”
“…I couldn’t stop him.”
“Oh, looks like Motoyasu-kun finally snapped out of his frozen state.”
“Judging from this, I take it Kou has messed up like this in previous loops too?”
Ren crossed his arms and asked. Ah, the nearby passersby seemed to understand that the commotion had settled down and continued on their way.
“That’s right. Back in one of Father’s previous loops, Kou had his eyes on the tail of a demi-human named Keel, one of his subordinates.”
“So he has a habit of seeing beast-like features as prey… Motoyasu, if you don’t want to traumatize him, you should have trained him properly from the start.”
“That’s impossible… Motoyasu-kun is way too hands-off. It’s like he physically can’t bring himself to scold anyone.”
“Still… Kou-san has gotten awfully quiet now, hasn’t he?”
Kou is either still sobbing or just staying quiet. But it’s fine. This won’t break his spirit. He’s simply come to understand who stands at the top of the pyramid.
“Father’s acting was incredible.”
“I know it’s not the best method, but… if I took my eyes off him and found out Imiya-chan had been eaten, well…”
As expected, Father is Father. I feel like he said something similar back when it was about Keel.
“At that level, it was necessary for education. But if you did that in Japan, it’d probably cause an uproar.”
“Even so, if words won’t work, you have no choice but to scold them.”
Hmm, Kou’s situation is unfortunate, but Ren and Itsuki’s opinions are reasonable. I can’t argue against them myself.
“Wait, so this kind of issue exists in Ren’s Japan too?”
“Yeah… I think it’s something unique to my world, but we have a problem called the ‘Virtual Parenting Issue’.”
“That’s a thing? Sounds kinda sci-fi.”
“I figured you’d latch onto that…”
The term alone isn’t enough to grasp it completely. Father seems interested.
“So, what kind of issue is it?”
“Ah, I guess you could call it neglectful parenting.”
“Oh, like leaving childcare to a VR program and ignoring it?”

“That’s about right. But it’s not just that. In my world, there are a lot of parents who can’t bring themselves to scold their kids. As a result, there are plenty of people who end up committing bizarre crimes.”
“Huh… I guess every world has its problems.”
“I see. So discipline is important.”
“Somehow, when Motoyasu says it, it doesn’t sit right with me… But, well, I guess strict discipline is necessary at times.”
That said, I could never bring myself to scold Kou. Though making him into hotpot is going too far.
“Still, Father’s acting really was terrifying.”
“You’re still on about that?”
“Ren-san, it’s always the gentle ones who are the scariest when they get mad. Let’s make sure we don’t anger Father.”
“Come on, it’s not like he’s quick to anger. I can’t even imagine what we’d have to do to make him that furious.”
“By the way, in the first world, Father was like that all the time.”
“What!?”
“Excuse me!?”
Ren and Itsuki’s voices cracked.
“Wait, wait. You’re saying Naofumi had that same fierce glare all the time?”
“And from what I hear, we were constantly at odds with him? With that Naofumi?”
“Uh… I think you guys are overreacting.”
Unlike the exasperated Father, Ren and Itsuki were completely serious. They were even stepping closer toward me.
“My past self must have had a death wish! What was I thinking!?”
“Seriously! Facing that version of Naofumi would have given me an ulcer!”
“Maybe you just underestimated shield users because they can’t attack?”
“This isn’t about whether he could attack or not!”
“Exactly! Just being glared at like that is terrifying enough!”
“Listen… You two need to calm down.”
Ren and Itsuki flinched and turned to look at Father. With a sigh, he ran a hand through his hair, looking exasperated.
“This situation was a one-time thing, so there’s no need to be that on edge. Kou seems to have learned his lesson too.”
That’s right. Father is a kind person. Given time, Kou will come to understand as well.
Hmm? Ren suddenly looked deep in thought.
“I see… So that’s what it was.”
Eventually, he nodded as if something had clicked for him. Motoyasu does not change how he addresses people.
